theme.text: This article critiques public health authorities' portrayal of vaccines, asserting that official claims about vaccine safety and benefits are misleading, involve significant scientific and ethical issues, and that the prevailing pro-vaccine narrative suppresses evidence and alternative perspectives.

thesis.text: Public health's 'truth' about vaccines, including claims of safety and efficacy, is often a fairy tale or dangerous disinformation; vaccines contain harmful substances and their safety and testing record are suspect, while vaccine injury and adverse effects have been systematically covered up and censored.

pillars.label: Vaccination attitudes and social divisions
pillars.text: There are three distinct groups regarding vaccines: non-vaccinating, often highly educated and scientifically literate parents; vaccinating parents who trust doctors and are open to evidence; and the fanatical 'Vaccines Amen' group that dogmatically defends vaccines and censors dissent.

pillars.label: CDC and vaccine industry misconduct and censorship
pillars.text: The CDC and pharmaceutical industry have engaged in data manipulation, cover-ups (e.g., MMR-autism link, thimerosal toxicity), censorship of dissenting views, and have influenced legislation that removes vaccination choice and suppresses vaccine safety concerns.

pillars.label: Rising chronic illness and infant death correlated with vaccination schedules
pillars.text: Since the 1986 removal of vaccine maker liability and the explosion in vaccine doses given to children, rates of chronic illness, neurodevelopmental disorders, and infant mortality (including SIDS) have increased dramatically in the U.S., with some data suggesting worse outcomes in heavily vaccinated infants.

pillars.label: Toxic substances in vaccines challenge official safety claims
pillars.text: Vaccines contain aluminum, mercury (thimerosal), formaldehyde, polysorbate 80 and other toxic substances at levels that exceed established safety limits and are linked to neurotoxicity, immune and developmental damage; these claims of safety are contradicted by scientific studies and regulatory documents.

pillars.label: Evidence of systemic suppression of independent research and alternative viewpoints
pillars.text: Local efforts to show vaccine injury documentaries, share vaccine safety research, or publish dissenting perspectives face censorship, refusals by venues and media, and social pressure to maintain the pro-vaccine narrative.

“Vaccines and sudden infant death: An analysis of the VAERS database 1990–2019 and review of the medical literature”
Does correlation imply causation?
In his 2021 report “Vaccines and sudden infant death: An analysis of the VAERS database 1990–2019 and review of the medical literature,” Miller explains:

“Throughout the 1980s, sudden infant deaths continued to skyrocket. Parental concerns about an apparent link between childhood vaccines and SIDS reached a fever pitch. Many parents were afraid to vaccinate their babies. Authorities sought to reassure parents that vaccines are safe and claimed that sudden unexplained infant deaths (SUID) following vaccines were merely coincidental.”
In a “Back to Sleep” campaign, parents were told that their babies’ sleeping position was the culprit — that they needed to be laid on their backs, not face down.
All coincidences?
So how do impacts from vaccines being injected in children compare to environmental exposures they face when “playing outside”?

“When we are healthy, enzymes in the mouth, acid in the stomach, and microbes in the lower gut will often destroy pathogens. If a pathogen escapes these first lines of digestive defense, then the villi will prevent their access to the bloodstream. If the villi are compromised, we have the physical barrier of the smooth muscular layer of the intestinal wall. In health, these systems function together to screen pathogens from the bloodstream. They are, in essence, guardians of our health.”
Looking at how vaccines can cause sudden infant death, Miller notes that “several theories regarding the pathogenic mechanism behind these fatal events have been proposed.”

“The ATSDR [Agency for Toxic Substances and Disease Registry] oral aluminum limit is based on 0.1% of oral aluminum being absorbed into the bloodstream, as the digestive tract blocks nearly all oral aluminum (Fig. 2a). “FDA regulations require safety testing of constituent ingredients in drugs (21 CFR 610.15). With the exception of extraneous proteins, no component safety testing is required for vaccines or vaccine schedules. The dosing of aluminum in vaccines is based on the production of antibody titers, not safety science .”

“If your baby weighs 7 pounds at birth (approximately 3 kilograms), the FDA stipulations suggest that the maximum safe dose for that newborn is 15 micrograms, sixteen times less than what is given in one hepatitis B vaccine. Since infants may not be able to effectively rid their bodies of aluminum, the truth is that no amount of aluminum is safe. By giving infants this shot, according to the FDA’s own calculations, we are literally poisoning them.”
“[Thimerosal] is toxic… Mutagenic in mammalian cells.“

“Comparing toxicity in two forms of mercury is like comparing the benefits of being shot with a .38 caliber bullet rather than a .45 caliber bullet. Most people would prefer Door #3: no bullet at all.”
“Forbidden Facts: Government Deceit & Suppression About Brain Damage from Childhood Vaccines”
Entire books have debunked the absurd statement “ethylmercury is NOT harmful to us.”

Contrary to our health department’s claim, it is highly neurotoxic — dangerous enough to cause “decreased offspring survival” as Eli Lilly was required by law to disclose in its Material Safety Data Sheet for thimerosal.
“A silvery white poisonous metallic element used in batteries and in the preparation of chemical pesticides.”
“…and in vaccines given to children and pregnant women.”
Injected ethylmercury has been shown to deposit in the brain and other organs far more readily than the much-publicized methylmercury in fish, which pregnant women are warned to avoid.
If it is so harmless, why would it have been removed from them?

“The number of dose related relationships [between mercury and autism] are linear and statistically significant,” said Dr. William Weil from the American Academy of Pediatrics. “You can play with this all you want. They are linear. They are statistically significant.”
The attendees were then asked What should we do now?

An immunologist told the assembled participants that he’d just taken an emergency call in which he’d advised his daughter-in-law who had delivered his first grandchild not to accept any mercury-laced vaccines.

“My mandate as I sit here in this group is to make sure at the end of the day that 100,000,000 are immunized with DTP, Hepatitis B and if possible Hib, this year, next year and for many years to come, and that will have to be with Thimerosal containing vaccines unless a miracle occurs and an alternative is found quickly and is tried and found to be safe. So I leave you with the challenge that I am very concerned that this has gotten this far, and that having got this far, how you present in a concerted voice the information to the ACIP in a way they will be able to handle it and not get exposed to the traps which are out there in public relations.”

pillars.label: Vaccination Attitudes and Social Dynamics
pillars.text: There are three distinct social groups regarding vaccines: highly educated vaccine refusers, vaccine acceptors who go with the flow, and zealous pro-vaccine 'Vaccines Amen' believers who demand conformity and censor dissent.

pillars.label: Historical Vaccine Data Integrity and Cover-ups
pillars.text: Studies linking vaccines (MMR, thimerosal) to autism and other harms were manipulated or suppressed by CDC scientists, leading to fraudulent conclusions and dismissal of parental concerns.

pillars.label: Industry Capture and Legal Immunity
pillars.text: The 1986 National Childhood Vaccine Injury Act removed liability from vaccine manufacturers, greatly increasing vaccine production and mandated schedules without corresponding safety responsibility.

pillars.label: Increases in Chronic Diseases Parallel to Vaccine Expansion
pillars.text: Chronic illness rates in U.S. children (including autism, ADHD, asthma) have sharply increased since widespread vaccination began, rising from negligible levels to over 54% by 2011.

pillars.label: Vaccine Ingredient Toxicity — Aluminum and Mercury
pillars.text: Aluminum adjuvants and ethylmercury-based thimerosal used in vaccines are highly toxic substances linked to neurological damage, autoimmune disorders, and other health issues; their dosing and regulation are inadequate or ignored in vaccines.

pillars.label: Censorship and Information Suppression
pillars.text: Efforts to challenge vaccine orthodoxy with alternative views and evidence are met with censorship, gatekeeping, and marginalization by media, community leaders, and public health authorities.
